notes.title: The Games Advent Calendar 2024 announcement!
notes.notes:
After the success of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445940/Games_Advent_Calendar__25_Days__25_Surprises/]Games Advent Calendar[/url] last year, we are proud to announce the Games Advent Calendar 2024! ☃️

Jump on a train packed with gifts and dive into the holiday spirit! 🚂 Travel by train through a magical winter wonderland. ❄️Your journey is 25 magical days from the first of December till Christmas. Go for the ultimate Advent Calendar experience by unlocking a new day every day, or just immediately unlock all the games if you can’t wait! 🎁

Experience some fan-favorite returning game concepts in a new setting or enjoy many new ones. From Bobsleigh Relay, Polar Cross, Snowdrift Racers, to Frostbreaker and many more. Play with up to 8 players by passing on the controller and see who will top the leaderboard. 🏔️

Games Advent Calendar 2024 is the perfect holiday treat, offering endless fun! 🌲 September 26th the game will be available digitally on PC Steam, Xbox Series S|X, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. Also coming to stores physically on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. 🛒

Visit our new store page below and wishlist now to stay up to date with our holiday adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2796390/Games_Advent_Calendar_2024/

notes.title: Merry Christmas and happy holidays!
notes.notes:
Christmas time is finally here! All of the doors have been unlocked and we hope you’ve enjoyed the wait leading up to the most wonderful time of the year! Which game was your favorite? If you haven’t played them all yet, don’t worry – you can play and replay each game all year long.

We wish everyone a very merry Christmas, and a happy 2024. Until next year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817367/a03215a48f092b3689f47aef85db3d274f53df68.png[/img]

notes.title: Did you already open today's door on the Advent Calendar: Puzzle Edition?
notes.notes:
A few days have passed, and a few games have already unlocked. Still, there is so much more to come! Hang in there and remember to check back every day for a new game!

Today we’ll find out what’s hiding behind door number 9 – Candy Lines! How long can you survive while new blocks appear? Clear lines of 5 blocks of the same color to gain points and clear the board. Can you beat your own top score?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817367/3f2913786571bf483aa1ca01429ac165b9a5358b.png[/img]

notes.title: The advent experience starts today!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Starting today, the advent season has officially kicked off, and for the next 24 days, a new game will unlock every day! For the full advent experience, check in every day to find what new game has unlocked. Have fun! 
 
Today, start the calendar with an exciting match 3 puzzle game. What new game will unlock tomorrow? Only time will tell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817367/1c88e9df7039fbdecf7ede3bde7d5a92cbd956c0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Wishing you a Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
The end of the holiday season experience is upon us! Celebrate Christmas with the last puzzle in Advent Calendar! Listen to some Christmas music and take a rest by your digital fireplace! Make sure to share the special holiday cheer with your friends and family!

We wish you a wonderful Christmas and a prosperous 2023! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817367/8d2e8c09e73770d6f174b42030982dd626511ba2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Celebrate the first of December with Advent Calendar!
notes.notes:
[b]Celebrate the start of the holiday season by opening the first present in Advent Calendar![/b]
 

Grab a warm pair of socks, a cup of hot chocolate and a warm blanket! December has officially started. 

Explore three Match 3 games with a festive twist today and make sure to open your present every single day for the remaining 24 days! Every present contains a different type of game, from Match 3, Candy Lines, Christmas puzzles, 2048 Presents, Pixel Art and Xmas Sudoku. Each day offers you multiple levels to play!

ADVENT CALENDAR is the ultimate holiday season experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817367/c7e230e2e1f1e1b38105c3c1b08b644632dc4995.png[/img]

notes.title: Advent Calendar Out Now - The Ultimate Holiday Experience!
notes.notes:
[b]Amstelveen November 10, 2022 – The holiday season is almost upon us! What is more fun than counting down to Christmas? Advent calendars make this something special for the family every year. This year is even more special, as Mindscape released the first-ever Advent Calendar for Nintendo Switch and PC today![/b]

[previewyoutube=mg9V_oek6fY;full][/previewyoutube]

Imagine every morning waking up during the holiday season and you get to open a new fantastic surprise. A surprise which you can play all day, every day. Grow your stack of presents with 25 different games, which all give you that special joyful Christmas cheer.
 
You will hardly be able to sleep because tomorrow another surprise is waiting for you. In Advent Calendar, each day you wake up to another challenging & exciting game. Many of these games you can also play with family and friends.

Players have the choice to open the entire calendar immediately, or choose the full Advent experience and start on December 1st to open a new gift every day.

Advent Calendar is now available on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
